patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "khosla ventures", 2026-09-23

profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit investor founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. It describes its focus as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. Its website also presents statements about AI's economic effects, including deflation over twenty-five years, changes to tax structures, and pressure on elite university business models.

The firm's site includes commentary on AI and labor, such as the claim that protecting employees from AI replacement will disadvantage companies or countries that do so, and a reference to a layoff explained by a note and a 24% increase in share price. It also mentions a $300,000 law or medical degree when discussing the possible collapse of elite universities' business model.

No products or individual cases are listed for the firm. The firm is associated with 281 legal exposure records in California.
